name: PPSH-41
description: Known affectionately as Papasha by Zarovian troops during World War II, the PPSH-41 features an extremely large magazine for its size. Its great weight and 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge means poor mobility and middling recoil, but its 1250 RPM means you'll never be wanting for more ammunition. Until you run out, at least.
